verdict.rationale: Trilegal is an Indian full-service law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software platform, so issuing scoped API credentials for agents is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows no API surface: every OpenAPI probe path returned 404, and the only machine-readable artifact is an llms.txt describing the firm.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
